title: Supplemental Benefits a Sponsoring Group May Buy on the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans
content:
Group dental cover, group vision cover and the network fitness membership are carried on a plan of the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans only where the schedule shows them. The over-the-counter allowance is loaded each calendar quarter and the embedded hearing aid allowance is granted per ear per plan year, both in USD.

| Group plan | Group dental | Group vision | Network fitness membership | Over-the-counter allowance each quarter | Hearing aid allowance per ear per plan year |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO) | No | No | Yes | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO) | Yes | Yes | Yes | 50.00 | 750.00 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) | Yes | Yes | Yes | 100.00 | 1250.00 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP) | No | No | No | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) | No | No | No | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP) | No | No | Yes | 50.00 | 0 |

## Reading of the schedule

The two allowance figures are granted on different bases and are never interchangeable: the over-the-counter figure is loaded once in each calendar quarter, so on a plan scheduled at 50.00 that amount is loaded once in each calendar quarter; the hearing aid figure is granted once in the plan year and once for each ear.

Dental and vision stand or fall together everywhere in this book, and both stand on Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO) and Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) alone.

The fitness membership does not follow them. It stands on four plans of the book, including Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP), which carries neither dental nor vision, and Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO), which carries neither and holds no allowance either.
